method: v3 12-Oct-26. Anchors — RATES: trend score (continuous, pts = min(|score|/0.6, 1) from 0.3); FX: fair value (≥1z, half-life ≤90d; pts = min(|z|/2, 1)) or the EUReka checklist; EQ/CMD: Bottoming entry, KOSPI washout/flow trigger, gold positioning ±thresholds, fair value. Trend outside rates is a ±0.25 confirmation leg (no provable timing edge in FX/EQ/CMD on 2015-26). Legs: FV ±(|z|/2) (veto ≥2z against), CTA crowding −0.75 ramp 1.25→1.75sd (veto ≥2.25sd) / flow +0.75 ramp 0.25→1.0sd (never an anchor), carry shown not scored, RSI ±0.25, EUReka ±0.5/0.75. Hysteresis: enter ≥1.0, exit <0.5; FULL ≥2.25 (down <2.0), HALF ≥1.5 (down <1.25), PROBE ≥1.0. Every change must be proposed on 3 consecutive runs; exits, downsizes and flips also wait 14 calendar days from entry; vetoes apply at once. FX VALUE-anchored cards are capped at PROBE until the pair passes the out-of-sample fade test (fv_oos.json); an FV leg whose model fails that test carries half weight.
